name: AI in Fintech/Payments — Competitor & Regulator Digest

parameters.content:
## AI in Fintech/Payments — Competitor & Regulator Digest

### How it works

This workflow runs every day at 8AM to collect fintech and payments competitor/regulator updates from configured RSS sources. It filters articles by lookback window, removes exact duplicates, then sends the remaining candidates to OpenAI for classification and semantic deduplication. It builds an email digest and sends it via Gmail when relevant articles exist, otherwise it exits without sending anything.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger timezone and run time if 8AM is not appropriate.
- Update the Config node with recipient email addresses, lookbackHours, openaiModel, and fromLabel values.
- Edit the Build Source List node to include the RSS feeds for competitors, regulators, and industry sources you want monitored.
- Add valid OpenAI API credentials or authorization headers for the OpenAI HTTP request node.
- Connect Gmail credentials and verify the sending account has permission to email the configured recipients.

### Customization

Adjust the article filtering logic, source list, digest format, and OpenAI prompt/model to match the regions, institutions, risk categories, or competitive topics your team tracks.

## Schedule and configure

Starts the daily workflow and sets core run parameters such as recipients, lookback window, model, and sender label before building the list of sources to check.

## Fetch and filter feeds

Retrieves RSS feed content, parses articles, filters them for the configured timeframe and relevance rules, and removes exact duplicates before AI processing.

## Classify and build digest

Prepares the OpenAI request, calls OpenAI to classify and deduplicate article candidates, then parses the AI response into a formatted email digest.

## Send or skip email

Checks whether the digest contains relevant articles, sends the Gmail digest when it does, or follows a no-op path when there is nothing to report.
